title: Softanza Graphics Engine — Where It Stands
thesis: Most of the field ships one lane well: Skia renders, D3 charts the web, Graphviz lays out graphs, spatstat does the statistics and draws nothing. Softanza is one Zig engine behind declarative Ring faces that reaches across twelve of those lanes at once; its advantage is being coherent across twelve lanes under one governed colour and text system, which no single competitor is.

lanes.note: SheenBidi -> HarfBuzz -> stb_truetype: bidi reorder, OpenType shaping, Arabic kashida justification at font-declared points, fallback chains, vertical CJK
OKLCH/Oklab throughout, monotonic ramps, a five-value semantic family under a constitution, ten themes, WCAG 2 + APCA contrast as gate-able numbers
44 projections with inverses, WGS84 geodesy, GeoJSON/TopoJSON, choropleth/symbol/flow/hex-bin, insets, Tissot, scale bar, north arrow, terminator
Clark-Evans z-test, Ripley K/L, G & F, envelopes, kernel density, contours, IDW, variograms, ordinary kriging with variance; seven null models
25+ notations all closed (DN0-DN24), many constraint-solved; own deterministic layout engine (GG1-GG6) plus a live picture-as-input mode
In-house wgpu surface: instanced multi-texture render and compute (matmul, fft, softmax, topk, pairdist) zero-copy on one device, W-string -> WGSL
Retained display-list canvas with an SVG floor that always answers, GPU-backed PNG; no Bezier/arc/AddPath, no transform stack, CPU rasteriser never written
An accessibility tree with roles, names, reading order and ToJSON, a screen-reader bridge, contrast maths gating colour; CVD simulation owed
SVG everywhere, lossless PNG with a returned encode decision, native window and browser tiers; no PDF/JPEG/WebP, only Windows runtime-verified
Bar, multi-bar, line, scatter, histogram, surface, treemap with SVG/PNG/terminal renderers; no pie/donut, area, heatmap, box/violin, candlestick
Canvas hit-testing (Pick), SVG ids/classes for hover, a drag-driven live diagram; animation and tweening explicitly deferred to GUI G5

lanes.lane: Perception — the plane can draw, not yet see
lanes.note: VISION plane's first rung: a draw->read round trip through Windows.Media.Ocr and onnxruntime (10 ms, glyph-accurate incl. Arabic shaping)

standouts: coherent across twelve lanes under one governed colour and text system
Arabic kashida justification at font-declared points
the rare lane where a graphics library also computes the statistics it draws
compute and render zero-copy on one wgpu device
